name: spot_prices
description: Day-ahead electricity spot prices from Energi Data Service (Energinet, Denmark/Nordic). Prices per bidding zone (PriceArea) in DKK and EUR per MWh: 15-minute intervals from 2025-10-01 (the day-ahead market moved to 15-minute products), hourly before that. Bidding zones: DK1 (west Denmark), DK2 (east Denmark), DE (Germany), NO2, SE3, SE4, and others. Omit "area" to get all zones. Keyless official open data.

area.description: Bidding zone, e.g. "DK1", "DK2", "DE". Omit for all areas.

limit.description: Max records (default 96, i.e. the last 24 hours of 15-minute rows for one area).

start.description: ISO date/time lower bound, e.g. "2026-06-01" or "2026-06-01T00:00".

name: co2_intensity
description: Real-time grid CO2 emission intensity (g CO2/kWh) from Energinet Denmark, sampled every 5 minutes per bidding zone (DK1=west, DK2=east); defaults to the last 12 readings (~1 hour). Lower values mean cleaner electricity.sampled every 5 minutes per bidding zone. Areas: DK1 (west Denmark), DK2 (east Denmark). Lower values mean cleaner electricity right now. Keyless official open data.

area.description: Bidding zone "DK1" or "DK2". Omit for both.

limit.description: Max records (default 12, i.e. last hour at 5-min resolution).

name: query_dataset
description: Generic escape hatch for any of the ~100 Energi Data Service (Energinet, Denmark) datasets. Examples: "ProductionConsumptionSettlement" (production/consumption by type per area+hour), "CO2EmisProg" (CO2 prognosis), "DayAheadPrices", "CO2Emis". Returns the raw records array for the dataset. Keyless official open data.

filter.description: Column→value[] filter, e.g. {"PriceArea":["DK1"]}. Values are arrays.
